items.author: Ojoswi Basu (3x Tableau Ambassador), Oct 29
items.summary: A Tableau Public "Profit by Month" area chart with a vertical-axis header that doesn't use Tableau's default style, an idea he credits to Andy Kriebel's Next-Level Tableau.

items.author: Tristan Guillevin (co-founder of LaDataViz), Oct 29
items.summary: LaDataViz Viz Extensions for Tableau now support custom color palettes: paste hex codes or import Preferences.tps, set a default, and your palettes appear first in every extension. The idea came from a question on Reddit's r/tableau.

items.author: Chimdindu Nwosu (Tableau Visionary and Ambassador), Oct 29
items.summary: When AI builds agentic dashboards, it needs machine-readable design standards to stay consistent at scale, so design systems will matter much more in analytics.

items.author: Le Luu (The Information Lab US), Oct 29
items.summary: DataDevQuest challenge DDQ2026-10, "Accessible SVG Exports with AI" (created by Pablo Gomez): export a Tableau view as PNG and SVG through the REST API, have an AI model describe the PNG, and write that description into the SVG's title and desc so screen readers can read the chart.

items.author: Tableau, reposted by Nick Brendes, Oct 29
items.summary: Tableau now has built-in integrations with ChatGPT and Codex that bring trusted insights and curated semantic models into the AI tools teams already use.
